summary: Which model, provider, params and job made this file - written into the file itself, so the record outlives the database row. PNG gets a lossless text chunk, JPEG a private APP1 marker spliced into container bytes with no re-encoding, MP4/MOV a uuid box appended after the media data so the absolute chunk offsets in moov stay valid, everything else a sidecar. Honest about what C2PA does that this does not. 164 tests.
key_features: Which model, provider, parameters and job made this file - written into the file itself, so the record outlives the database row
PNG gets a lossless text chunk; JPEG gets a private APP1 marker spliced into container bytes with no re-encoding
MP4/M4V/M4A/MOV get a uuid box appended after the media data - nothing stco/co64 points at ever moves, and any edit that would move it is refused
Verified against real ffmpeg-encoded clips by comparing decoded output, not just file structure
Anything else gets a sidecar file rather than a silent failure
Honest about what C2PA does that this does not
